name: loomy-cartoon3d
description: Source of cartoon/js/c3d/cartoon3d.js: the cartoon-3d-short engine (MIT, claude-animated-shorts bridge template) with a browser driver. Build: npm install && npm run build

scripts.build: esbuild src/driver.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:three --outfile=../../cartoon/js/c3d/cartoon3d.js && esbuild src/toon2d.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=../../cartoon/js/c3d/toon2d.js && esbuild src/maps3d.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:three --outfile=../../explainer/js/z3d/maps3d.js
